ko.title: 어닝 시즌 개막: 대형 은행 실적 발표가 미국 소비자에 대해 시사하는 바

segments.src: Third-quarter earnings season is about to begin, and the first reports will come from the country's largest lenders.
segments.tr: 3분기 어닝 시즌이 곧 시작되며, 첫 실적 발표는 미국 최대 은행들로부터 나올 예정입니다.

segments.src: Investors usually watch these results for profit figures.
segments.tr: 투자자들은 보통 이러한 실적에서 이익 수치를 주목합니다.

segments.src: This quarter they will also read them as a check on household finances, because the banks see how millions of Americans borrow, spend and repay.
segments.tr: 이번 분기에는 가계 재정 상태를 점검하는 지표로도 실적을 읽을 것인데, 은행들은 수백만 명의 미국인들이 어떻게 빌리고, 쓰고, 갚는지를 보고 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## Why Bank Earnings Matter Beyond Wall Street
segments.tr: ## 월스트리트 그 이상으로 은행 실적이 중요한 이유

segments.src: Large banks sit at the center of consumer finance.
segments.tr: 대형 은행들은 소비자 금융의 중심에 있습니다.

segments.src: They issue credit cards, make auto and home loans, and process a large share of daily card payments.
segments.tr: 이들은 신용카드를 발급하고, 자동차 및 주택 담보 대출을 제공하며, 일일 카드 결제의 상당 부분을 처리합니다.

segments.src: Their quarterly reports, and the commentary from executives on calls with analysts, offer a broad view of how households are doing.
segments.tr: 이들의 분기별 보고서와 애널리스트와의 전화 회의에서 경영진이 밝히는 의견은 가계가 어떻게 지내고 있는지에 대한 폭넓은 시각을 제공합니다.

segments.src: That view is more current than many government statistics, which often arrive with a delay.
segments.tr: 이러한 시각은 종종 지연되어 발표되는 많은 정부 통계보다 더 최신의 정보를 담고 있습니다.

segments.src: This quarter's question is whether consumers are managing under high interest rates and elevated prices.
segments.tr: 이번 분기의 화두는 소비자들이 높은 금리와 고물가 속에서도 잘 버텨내고 있는지 여부입니다.

segments.src: Borrowing costs have stayed high for a long time, and the price of groceries, housing and insurance remains well above where it stood a few years ago.
segments.tr: 대출 비용은 오랫동안 높은 수준을 유지해 왔으며, 식료품, 주거비, 보험료 가격은 몇 년 전 수준을 훨씬 웃돌고 있습니다.

segments.src: Banks' own data should show how much strain that has caused.
segments.tr: 은행 자체 데이터는 이것이 얼마나 많은 부담을 주었는지 보여줄 것입니다.

segments.src: ## Three Things Investors Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## 투자자들이 주목할 세 가지

segments.src: ### 1. Loan Defaults and Charge-Offs
segments.tr: ### 1. 대출 연체 및 대손 상각

segments.src: The first area is credit quality.
segments.tr: 첫 번째 분야는 신용 품질입니다.

segments.src: Analysts will look at **delinquency rates**, meaning the share of borrowers who have fallen behind on payments.
segments.tr: 애널리스트들은 대출금 상환이 지연된 차입자의 비율을 의미하는 **연체율**을 살펴볼 것입니다.

segments.src: They will also look at **net charge-offs**, meaning the debts a bank has given up on collecting.
segments.tr: 또한 은행이 회수를 포기한 채무를 의미하는 **순대손상각**도 살펴볼 것입니다.

segments.src: Rising numbers here would suggest that some households are running out of room.
segments.tr: 이 수치가 상승한다는 것은 일부 가계가 한계에 다다르고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: A stable or improving trend would support the view that the consumer is holding up.
segments.tr: 안정적이거나 개선되는 추세는 소비자가 잘 버티고 있다는 견해를 뒷받침할 것입니다.

segments.src: Investors will also check how much money banks have set aside as a cushion for future losses, known as **loan-loss provisions**.
segments.tr: 투자자들은 또한 은행들이 향후 손실에 대비해 완충 장치로 적립해 둔 자금인 **대손충당금**을 얼마나 설정했는지 확인할 것입니다.

segments.src: A bank that increases its reserves is signaling more caution about what comes next.
segments.tr: 충당금을 늘리는 은행은 앞으로 다가올 상황에 대해 더 조심스러운 태도를 취하고 있다는 신호입니다.

segments.src: ### 2. Credit Card Balances
segments.tr: ### 2. 신용카드 잔액

segments.src: Credit card debt is a key indicator of household stress.
segments.tr: 신용카드 부채는 가계 스트레스의 핵심 지표입니다.

segments.src: Balances have grown over the past several years, and card interest rates are high.
segments.tr: 잔액은 지난 몇 년 동안 증가해 왔으며, 카드 이자율도 높습니다.

segments.src: Analysts will compare balance growth with the pace of spending to judge whether people are borrowing for convenience or because they need to cover everyday costs.
segments.tr: 애널리스트들은 잔액 증가세와 소비 속도를 비교하여 사람들이 편리함을 위해 돈을 빌리는 것인지, 아니면 일상적인 비용을 충당하기 위해 빌리는 것인지 판단할 것입니다.

segments.src: Payment behavior matters as well.
segments.tr: 결제 행태 역시 중요합니다.

segments.src: If more cardholders are paying only the minimum, or if late payments are increasing, that can be an early sign of trouble.
segments.tr: 최소 결제 금액만 납부하는 카드 소지자가 늘어나거나 연체가 증가한다면 이는 문제의 조기 신호일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Lenders often say which income groups are driving these trends, and those comments can be informative.
segments.tr: 대출 기관들은 종종 어떤 소득 계층이 이러한 추세를 주도하고 있는지 밝히며, 이러한 언급은 유용한 정보가 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 3. Consumer Spending Patterns
segments.tr: ### 3. 소비자 지출 패턴

segments.src: Banks also report how much customers are spending on debit and credit cards.
segments.tr: 은행들은 또한 고객들이 직불카드와 신용카드로 얼마나 지출하고 있는지를 보고합니다.

segments.src: This gives a near real-time reading on the economy, since consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: 소비자 지출이 미국 경제 활동의 약 3분의 2를 차지하기 때문에, 이는 경제에 대한 실시간에 가까운 지표를 제공합니다.

segments.src: economic activity.
Analysts will look at whether spending is broad-based or concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: 애널리스트들은 지출이 광범위하게 이루어지고 있는지, 아니면 고소득 가계에 집중되어 있는지 살펴볼 것입니다.

segments.src: In recent quarters, some lenders have described a "two-speed" consumer.
segments.tr: 최근 분기 동안 일부 대출 기관들은 '양극화된(two-speed)' 소비자에 대해 설명해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Wealthier households continue to spend on travel and dining, while lower- and middle-income households are more careful and look for deals.
segments.tr: 부유한 가계는 여행과 외식에 계속 지출하는 반면, 저소득 및 중소득 가계는 더 신중하게 소비하며 할인 상품을 찾고 있습니다.

segments.src: Executives' remarks on this split are likely to draw attention.
segments.tr: 이러한 격차에 대한 경영진의 발언은 주목을 받을 가능성이 높습니다.

segments.src: ## Other Factors in the Picture
segments.tr: ## 고려해야 할 다른 요인들

segments.src: Bank profits depend on more than consumer behavior.
segments.tr: 은행의 이익은 소비자 행동에만 달려 있는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Several other themes may come up in this round of reports:
segments.tr: 이번 실적 발표에서는 다음과 같은 몇 가지 다른 주제도 제기될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Net interest income:** The gap between what banks earn on loans and what they pay on deposits. Changes in interest rates affect this figure.
segments.tr: - **순이자마진(NII):** 은행이 대출로 벌어들이는 수익과 예금에 대해 지급하는 이자 간의 차이입니다. 금리 변화가 이 수치에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: - **Investment banking and trading:** Revenue from deal-making and markets can offset weakness elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **투자은행(IB) 및 트레이딩:** 딜 메이킹과 시장에서 발생하는 수익은 다른 부문의 약세를 상쇄할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Commercial real estate:** Some lenders still face questions about office properties and other commercial loans.
segments.tr: - **상업용 부동산:** 일부 대출 기관은 여전히 오피스 빌딩 및 기타 상업용 대출에 대한 의문에 직면해 있습니다.

segments.src: - **The labor market:** Job security is the main support for household finances. Executives' comments on employment trends among their customers can shape how investors read the results.
segments.tr: - **노동 시장:** 고용 안정성은 가계 재정의 가장 큰 버팀목입니다. 고객들의 고용 추세에 대한 경영진의 언급은 투자자들이 실적을 해석하는 방식을 결정할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Results
segments.tr: ## 실적 보고서를 읽는 방법

segments.src: A single quarter rarely settles the debate.
segments.tr: 단 한 분기의 실적만으로 논쟁이 해결되는 경우는 드뭅니다.

segments.src: Some tips for making sense of the headlines:
segments.tr: 헤드라인을 이해하기 위한 몇 가지 팁은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: 1. **Look at trends, not one number.** Compare results with prior quarters and with the same period a year ago.
segments.tr: 1. **단일 수치가 아닌 추세를 보십시오.** 실적을 이전 분기 및 전년 동기와 비교해 보십시오.

segments.src: 2. **Pay attention to the tone of management.** Words such as "resilient," "normalizing" or "cautious" can signal how executives see the months ahead.
segments.tr: 2. **경영진의 어조에 주의를 기울이십시오.** '회복력 있는(resilient)', '정상화되는(normalizing)' 또는 '신중한(cautious)'과 같은 단어는 경영진이 향후 몇 달을 어떻게 바라보고 있는지 신호를 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Compare across banks.** Lenders serve different customers, so differences between them can reveal where stress is building.
segments.tr: 3. **은행 간 비교를 해보십시오.** 대출 기관마다 서비스하는 고객이 다르므로, 이들 간의 차이를 통해 어디에서 스트레스가 쌓이고 있는지 파악할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Remember the limits.** Bank data covers their own customers and may not represent every household.
segments.tr: 4. **한계점을 기억하십시오.** 은행 데이터는 자체 고객만을 대상으로 하므로 모든 가계를 대변하지는 못할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## 일반 가계에 미치는 의미

segments.src: For people outside the investing world, these reports are still a useful guide.
segments.tr: 투자 업계 밖에 있는 사람들에게도 이러한 보고서는 여전히 유용한 가이드가 됩니다.

segments.src: They can indicate whether credit may become harder to get, whether lenders expect more borrowers to struggle, and how companies see the strength of the economy.
segments.tr: 신용을 얻기가 더 어려워질지, 대출 기관들이 더 많은 차입자가 어려움을 겪을 것으로 예상하는지, 그리고 기업들이 경제 체력을 어떻게 보는지 나타낼 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: If banks report rising defaults and tighter lending standards, borrowing could become more expensive or harder to qualify for.
segments.tr: 은행들이 연체율 상승과 대출 기준 강화를 보고한다면, 대출 비용이 더 비싸지거나 자격을 갖추기가 더 어려워질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If they report solid repayment and steady spending, that supports the case that the economy is on stable footing.
segments.tr: 반면 견조한 상환과 꾸준한 지출을 보고한다면, 이는 경제가 안정적인 기반 위에 있다는 주장을 뒷받침합니다.

segments.src: Whatever the numbers show, it is a good time for households to review their own finances: check card balances and interest rates, build an emergency fund where possible, and understand the terms of any variable-rate debt.
segments.tr: 수치가 어떻게 나오든, 지금은 가계가 스스로의 재정 상태를 점검하기 좋은 시기입니다. 카드 잔액과 이자율을 확인하고, 가능한 경우 비상금을 마련하며, 변동금리 부채의 조건을 파악해 두십시오.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: The coming bank reports will offer an early and detailed look at the state of the American consumer.
segments.tr: 다가오는 은행 실적 발표는 미국 소비자의 상태를 조기에 상세히 보여줄 것입니다.

segments.src: Investors will be searching for signs of whether households can keep up with high rates and prices.
segments.tr: 투자자들은 가계가 높은 금리와 물가를 계속 감당할 수 있을지 그 단서를 찾을 것입니다.

segments.src: The answers will influence expectations for the economy, for interest rates and for the earnings reports that follow from companies across the market.
segments.tr: 그 결과는 경제, 금리, 그리고 시장 전반의 기업들이 이어갈 실적 발표에 대한 기대치에 영향을 미칠 것입니다.

zh.title: 财报季拉开帷幕：大型银行财报能揭示美国消费者的哪些情况

segments.src: Third-quarter earnings season is about to begin, and the first reports will come from the country's largest lenders.
segments.tr: 第三季度财报季即将开始，首批报告将来自该国最大的几家贷款机构。

segments.src: Investors usually watch these results for profit figures.
segments.tr: 投资者通常会从这些业绩中关注利润数据。

segments.src: This quarter they will also read them as a check on household finances, because the banks see how millions of Americans borrow, spend and repay.
segments.tr: 本季度，他们还将这些报告解读为对家庭财务状况的检视，因为银行能够观察到数百万美国人是如何借款、消费和还款的。

segments.src: ## Why Bank Earnings Matter Beyond Wall Street
segments.tr: ## 为什么银行财报不仅对华尔街重要

segments.src: Large banks sit at the center of consumer finance.
segments.tr: 大型银行处于消费金融的核心位置。

segments.src: They issue credit cards, make auto and home loans, and process a large share of daily card payments.
segments.tr: 它们发行信用卡，发放汽车贷款和房屋贷款，并处理日常刷卡支付的大部分份额。

segments.src: Their quarterly reports, and the commentary from executives on calls with analysts, offer a broad view of how households are doing.
segments.tr: 它们的季度报告以及高管在分析师电话会议上的评论，为了解家庭财务状况提供了广泛的视角。

segments.src: That view is more current than many government statistics, which often arrive with a delay.
segments.tr: 这种视角比许多通常带有滞后性的政府统计数据更加及时。

segments.src: This quarter's question is whether consumers are managing under high interest rates and elevated prices.
segments.tr: 本季度的问题在于，消费者在高利率和高物价的压力下是否应对得当。

segments.src: Borrowing costs have stayed high for a long time, and the price of groceries, housing and insurance remains well above where it stood a few years ago.
segments.tr: 借贷成本长期居高不下，杂货、住房和保险的价格仍然远高于几年前的水平。

segments.src: Banks' own data should show how much strain that has caused.
segments.tr: 银行自己的数据应该能显示这造成了多大的压力。

segments.src: ## Three Things Investors Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## 投资者将关注的三件事

segments.src: ### 1. Loan Defaults and Charge-Offs
segments.tr: ### 1. 贷款违约与核销

segments.src: The first area is credit quality.
segments.tr: 第一个领域是信用质量。

segments.src: Analysts will look at **delinquency rates**, meaning the share of borrowers who have fallen behind on payments.
segments.tr: 分析师将审视 **delinquency rates**，即未能按时还款的借款人比例。

segments.src: They will also look at **net charge-offs**, meaning the debts a bank has given up on collecting.
segments.tr: 他们还将审视 **net charge-offs**，即银行已放弃追讨的债务。

segments.src: Rising numbers here would suggest that some households are running out of room.
segments.tr: 这里不断上升的数字将表明，一些家庭的财务空间正在耗尽。

segments.src: A stable or improving trend would support the view that the consumer is holding up.
segments.tr: 稳定或改善的趋势将支持消费者正在撑住的观点。

segments.src: Investors will also check how much money banks have set aside as a cushion for future losses, known as **loan-loss provisions**.
segments.tr: 投资者还将检查银行预留了多少资金作为未来损失的缓冲，这被称为 **loan-loss provisions**。

segments.src: A bank that increases its reserves is signaling more caution about what comes next.
segments.tr: 增加准备金的银行传递出对未来更加谨慎的信号。

segments.src: ### 2. Credit Card Balances
segments.tr: ### 2. 信用卡余额

segments.src: Credit card debt is a key indicator of household stress.
segments.tr: 信用卡债务是衡量家庭压力的一个关键指标。

segments.src: Balances have grown over the past several years, and card interest rates are high.
segments.tr: 过去几年余额一直在增长，而且信用卡利率很高。

segments.src: Analysts will compare balance growth with the pace of spending to judge whether people are borrowing for convenience or because they need to cover everyday costs.
segments.tr: 分析师会将余额增长与消费步伐进行比较，以判断人们借款是为了图方便还是因为需要支付日常生活开销。

segments.src: Payment behavior matters as well.
segments.tr: 还款行为也很重要。

segments.src: If more cardholders are paying only the minimum, or if late payments are increasing, that can be an early sign of trouble.
segments.tr: 如果越来越多的持卡人只偿还最低还款额，或者逾期付款在增加，这可能是麻烦的早期信号。

segments.src: Lenders often say which income groups are driving these trends, and those comments can be informative.
segments.tr: 贷款机构通常会说明是哪些收入群体在推动这些趋势，这些评论可以提供很多信息。

segments.src: ### 3. Consumer Spending Patterns
segments.tr: ### 3. 消费者消费模式

segments.src: Banks also report how much customers are spending on debit and credit cards.
segments.tr: 银行还会报告客户在借记卡和信用卡上的消费金额。

segments.src: This gives a near real-time reading on the economy, since consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: 由于消费者支出占美国经济活动的约三分之二，这为经济提供了近乎实时的读数。

segments.src: economic activity.
segments.tr: 经济活动。

segments.src: Analysts will look at whether spending is broad-based or concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: 分析师将观察消费是普遍增长，还是集中在高收入家庭。

segments.src: In recent quarters, some lenders have described a "two-speed" consumer.
segments.tr: 最近几个季度，一些贷款机构描述了“双速”消费者。

segments.src: Wealthier households continue to spend on travel and dining, while lower- and middle-income households are more careful and look for deals.
segments.tr: 较富裕的家庭继续在旅游和餐饮上消费，而中低收入家庭则更加谨慎并寻找优惠。

segments.src: Executives' remarks on this split are likely to draw attention.
segments.tr: 高管们对这种分化的言论可能会引起关注。

segments.src: ## Other Factors in the Picture
segments.tr: ## 图景中的其他因素

segments.src: Bank profits depend on more than consumer behavior.
segments.tr: 银行利润不仅仅取决于消费者的行为。

segments.src: Several other themes may come up in this round of reports:
segments.tr: 这轮财报中可能会出现其他几个主题：

segments.src: - **Net interest income:** The gap between what banks earn on loans and what they pay on deposits. Changes in interest rates affect this figure.
segments.tr: - **Net interest income:** 银行从贷款中获得的收益与它们在存款上支付的利息之间的差距。利率的变化会影响这一数字。

segments.src: - **Investment banking and trading:** Revenue from deal-making and markets can offset weakness elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Investment banking and trading:** 来自交易撮合和市场的收入可以抵消其他地方的疲软。

segments.src: - **Commercial real estate:** Some lenders still face questions about office properties and other commercial loans.
segments.tr: - **Commercial real estate:** 一些贷款机构仍然面临关于办公物业和其他商业贷款的问题。

segments.src: - **The labor market:** Job security is the main support for household finances. Executives' comments on employment trends among their customers can shape how investors read the results.
segments.tr: - **The labor market:** 就业安全是家庭财务的主要支撑。高管们对其客户就业趋势的评论可以塑造投资者对财报结果的解读。

segments.src: ## How to Read the Results
segments.tr: ## 如何解读财报结果

segments.src: A single quarter rarely settles the debate.
segments.tr: 单一季度的财报很少能一锤定音。

segments.src: Some tips for making sense of the headlines:
segments.tr: 理解这些头条新闻的一些小建议：

segments.src: 1. **Look at trends, not one number.** Compare results with prior quarters and with the same period a year ago.
segments.tr: 1. **Look at trends, not one number.** 将结果与前几个季度以及去年同期进行比较。

segments.src: 2. **Pay attention to the tone of management.** Words such as "resilient," "normalizing" or "cautious" can signal how executives see the months ahead.
segments.tr: 2. **Pay attention to the tone of management.** 诸如“具有韧性”、“正常化”或“谨慎”等词汇可以表明高管们如何看待未来几个月。

segments.src: 3. **Compare across banks.** Lenders serve different customers, so differences between them can reveal where stress is building.
segments.tr: 3. **Compare across banks.** 贷款机构服务于不同的客户，因此它们之间的差异可以揭示压力正在哪里积聚。

segments.src: 4. **Remember the limits.** Bank data covers their own customers and may not represent every household.
segments.tr: 4. **Remember the limits.** 银行数据涵盖其自身的客户，可能并不代表每一个家庭。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## 这对普通家庭意味着什么

segments.src: For people outside the investing world, these reports are still a useful guide.
segments.tr: 对于投资界以外的人来说，这些报告仍然是一个有用的指南。

segments.src: They can indicate whether credit may become harder to get, whether lenders expect more borrowers to struggle, and how companies see the strength of the economy.
segments.tr: 它们可以表明信贷是否会变得更难获得，贷款机构是否预计会有更多借款人陷入挣扎，以及公司如何看待经济的强劲程度。

segments.src: If banks report rising defaults and tighter lending standards, borrowing could become more expensive or harder to qualify for.
segments.tr: 如果银行报告违约率上升且贷款标准收紧，借贷成本可能会变得更高或更难符合资格。

segments.src: If they report solid repayment and steady spending, that supports the case that the economy is on stable footing.
segments.tr: 如果它们报告稳健的还款情况和稳定的支出，那将支持经济处于稳固基础上的观点。

segments.src: Whatever the numbers show, it is a good time for households to review their own finances: check card balances and interest rates, build an emergency fund where possible, and understand the terms of any variable-rate debt.
segments.tr: 无论数字显示什么，对于家庭来说，这都是审视自身财务状况的好时机：检查卡片余额和利率，在可能的情况下建立应急基金，并了解任何浮动利率债务的条款。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The coming bank reports will offer an early and detailed look at the state of the American consumer.
segments.tr: 即将发布的银行财报将为美国消费者的状况提供早期且详细的审视。

segments.src: Investors will be searching for signs of whether households can keep up with high rates and prices.
segments.tr: 投资者将寻找家庭能否跟上高利率和高物价步伐的迹象。

segments.src: The answers will influence expectations for the economy, for interest rates and for the earnings reports that follow from companies across the market.
segments.tr: 这些答案将影响对经济、利率以及随后市场中各公司财报的预期。

segments.src: Third-quarter earnings season is about to begin, and the first reports will come from the country's largest lenders.
segments.tr: तीसरी तिमाही की कमाई का मौसम शुरू होने वाला है, और पहली रिपोर्ट देश के सबसे बड़े ऋणदाताओं से आएगी।

segments.src: Investors usually watch these results for profit figures.
segments.tr: निवेशक आमतौर पर लाभ के आंकड़ों के लिए इन परिणामों को देखते हैं।

segments.src: This quarter they will also read them as a check on household finances, because the banks see how millions of Americans borrow, spend and repay.
segments.tr: इस तिमाही वे घरेलू वित्त की जाँच के रूप में भी इन्हें पढ़ेंगे, क्योंकि बैंक देखते हैं कि लाखों अमेरिकी कैसे उधार लेते हैं, खर्च करते हैं और चुकाते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why Bank Earnings Matter Beyond Wall Street
segments.tr: ## वॉल स्ट्रीट से परे बैंक की कमाई क्यों मायने रखती है

segments.src: Large banks sit at the center of consumer finance.
segments.tr: बड़े बैंक उपभोक्ता वित्त के केंद्र में बैठे हैं।

segments.src: They issue credit cards, make auto and home loans, and process a large share of daily card payments.
segments.tr: वे क्रेडिट कार्ड जारी करते हैं, ऑटो और होम लोन देते हैं, और दैनिक कार्ड भुगतानों का एक बड़ा हिस्सा संसाधित करते हैं।

segments.src: Their quarterly reports, and the commentary from executives on calls with analysts, offer a broad view of how households are doing.
segments.tr: उनकी त्रैमासिक रिपोर्टें, और विश्लेषकों के साथ कॉल पर अधिकारियों की टिप्पणी, एक व्यापक दृष्टिकोण प्रदान करती हैं कि परिवार कैसा कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: That view is more current than many government statistics, which often arrive with a delay.
segments.tr: यह दृष्टिकोण कई सरकारी आंकड़ों की तुलना में अधिक वर्तमान है, जो अक्सर देरी से आते हैं।

segments.src: This quarter's question is whether consumers are managing under high interest rates and elevated prices.
segments.tr: इस तिमाही का सवाल यह है कि क्या उपभोक्ता उच्च ब्याज दरों और बढ़े हुए मूल्यों के तहत प्रबंधन कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Borrowing costs have stayed high for a long time, and the price of groceries, housing and insurance remains well above where it stood a few years ago.
segments.tr: उधार लेने की लागत लंबे समय से उच्च बनी हुई है, और किराने का सामान, आवास और बीमा की कीमत कुछ साल पहले की तुलना में काफी ऊपर बनी हुई है।

segments.src: Banks' own data should show how much strain that has caused.
segments.tr: बैंकों का अपना डेटा यह दिखाना चाहिए कि इससे कितना तनाव पैदा हुआ है।

segments.src: ## Three Things Investors Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## तीन चीजें जिन पर निवेशक नजर रखेंगे

segments.src: ### 1. Loan Defaults and Charge-Offs
segments.tr: ### 1. लोन डिफॉल्ट और चार्ज-ऑफ

segments.src: The first area is credit quality.
segments.tr: पहला क्षेत्र क्रेडिट गुणवत्ता है।

segments.src: Analysts will look at **delinquency rates**, meaning the share of borrowers who have fallen behind on payments.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक **delinquency rates** को देखेंगे, जिसका अर्थ है उन उधारकर्ताओं का हिस्सा जो भुगतान में पिछड़ गए हैं।

segments.src: They will also look at **net charge-offs**, meaning the debts a bank has given up on collecting.
segments.tr: वे **net charge-offs** को भी देखेंगे, जिसका अर्थ है वे ऋण जिन्हें बैंक ने वसूलना छोड़ दिया है।

segments.src: Rising numbers here would suggest that some households are running out of room.
segments.tr: यहां बढ़ती संख्या यह सुझाव देगी कि कुछ परिवारों की जगह खत्म हो रही है।

segments.src: A stable or improving trend would support the view that the consumer is holding up.
segments.tr: एक स्थिर या सुधारती हुई प्रवृत्ति इस दृष्टिकोण का समर्थन करेगी कि उपभोक्ता टिके हुए हैं।

segments.src: Investors will also check how much money banks have set aside as a cushion for future losses, known as **loan-loss provisions**.
segments.tr: निवेशक यह भी जाँचेंगे कि भविष्य के नुकसान के लिए कुशन के रूप में बैंकों ने कितना पैसा अलग रखा है, जिसे **loan-loss provisions** कहा जाता है।

segments.src: A bank that increases its reserves is signaling more caution about what comes next.
segments.tr: एक बैंक जो अपने आरक्षित को बढ़ाता है, वह आगे क्या आता है इसके बारे में अधिक सावधानी का संकेत दे रहा है।

segments.src: ### 2. Credit Card Balances
segments.tr: ### 2. क्रेडिट कार्ड बैलेंस

segments.src: Credit card debt is a key indicator of household stress.
segments.tr: क्रेडिट कार्ड ऋण घरेलू तनाव का एक प्रमुख संकेतक है।

segments.src: Balances have grown over the past several years, and card interest rates are high.
segments.tr: पिछले कई वर्षों में बैलेंस बढ़े हैं, और कार्ड ब्याज दरें उच्च हैं।

segments.src: Analysts will compare balance growth with the pace of spending to judge whether people are borrowing for convenience or because they need to cover everyday costs.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक यह न्याय करने के लिए खर्च की गति के साथ बैलेंस वृद्धि की तुलना करेंगे कि क्या लोग सुविधा के लिए उधार ले रहे हैं या इसलिए कि उन्हें रोजमर्रा की लागतों को कवर करने की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: Payment behavior matters as well.
segments.tr: भुगतान व्यवहार भी मायने रखता है।

segments.src: If more cardholders are paying only the minimum, or if late payments are increasing, that can be an early sign of trouble.
segments.tr: यदि अधिक कार्डधारक केवल न्यूनतम भुगतान कर रहे हैं, या यदि देर से भुगतान बढ़ रहे हैं, तो यह परेशानी का शुरुआती संकेत हो सकता है।

segments.src: Lenders often say which income groups are driving these trends, and those comments can be informative.
segments.tr: ऋणदाता अक्सर कहते हैं कि कौन से आय समूह इन रुझानों को चला रहे हैं, और वे टिप्पणियां जानकारीपूर्ण हो सकती हैं।

segments.src: ### 3. Consumer Spending Patterns
segments.tr: ### 3. उपभोक्ता खर्च के पैटर्न

segments.src: Banks also report how much customers are spending on debit and credit cards.
segments.tr: बैंक यह भी रिपोर्ट करते हैं कि ग्राहक डेबिट और क्रेडिट कार्ड पर कितना खर्च कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: This gives a near real-time reading on the economy, since consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: यह अर्थव्यवस्था पर लगभग वास्तविक समय की रीडिंग देता है, चूंकि उपभोक्ता खर्च यू.एस. के लगभग दो-तिहाई हिस्से के लिए जिम्मेदार है।

segments.src: economic activity.
segments.tr: आर्थिक गतिविधि।

segments.src: Analysts will look at whether spending is broad-based or concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक यह देखेंगे कि क्या खर्च व्यापक आधारित है या उच्च आय वाले परिवारों के बीच केंद्रित है।

segments.src: In recent quarters, some lenders have described a "two-speed" consumer.
segments.tr: हाल की तिमाहियों में, कुछ ऋणदाताओं ने "two-speed" उपभोक्ता का वर्णन किया है।

segments.src: Wealthier households continue to spend on travel and dining, while lower- and middle-income households are more careful and look for deals.
segments.tr: अमीर परिवार यात्रा और भोजन पर खर्च करना जारी रखते हैं, जबकि निचले और मध्यम आय वाले परिवार अधिक सावधान हैं और सौदों की तलाश करते हैं।

segments.src: Executives' remarks on this split are likely to draw attention.
segments.tr: इस विभाजन पर अधिकारियों की टिप्पणी का ध्यान आकर्षित करने की संभावना है।

segments.src: ## Other Factors in the Picture
segments.tr: ## तस्वीर में अन्य कारक

segments.src: Bank profits depend on more than consumer behavior.
segments.tr: बैंक का मुनाफा उपभोक्ता व्यवहार से अधिक पर निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: Several other themes may come up in this round of reports:
segments.tr: रिपोर्टों के इस दौर में कई अन्य विषय आ सकते हैं:

segments.src: - **Net interest income:** The gap between what banks earn on loans and what they pay on deposits. Changes in interest rates affect this figure.
segments.tr: - **Net interest income:** ऋण पर बैंक क्या कमाते हैं और जमा पर क्या भुगतान करते हैं, इसके बीच का अंतर। ब्याज दरों में परिवर्तन इस आंकड़े को प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Investment banking and trading:** Revenue from deal-making and markets can offset weakness elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Investment banking and trading:** डील-मेकिंग और बाजारों से राजस्व अन्य जगहों पर कमजोरी की भरपाई कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Commercial real estate:** Some lenders still face questions about office properties and other commercial loans.
segments.tr: - **Commercial real estate:** कुछ ऋणदाता अभी भी कार्यालय संपत्तियों और अन्य व्यावसायिक ऋणों के बारे में सवालों का सामना करते हैं।

segments.src: - **The labor market:** Job security is the main support for household finances. Executives' comments on employment trends among their customers can shape how investors read the results.
segments.tr: - **The labor market:** नौकरी की सुरक्षा घरेलू वित्त के लिए मुख्य समर्थन है। अपने ग्राहकों के बीच रोजगार के रुझान पर अधिकारियों की टिप्पणियां आकार दे सकती हैं कि निवेशक परिणामों को कैसे पढ़ते हैं।

segments.src: ## How to Read the Results
segments.tr: ## परिणामों को कैसे पढ़ें

segments.src: A single quarter rarely settles the debate.
segments.tr: एक ही तिमाही शायद ही कभी बहस का निपटारा करती है।

segments.src: Some tips for making sense of the headlines:
segments.tr: सुर्खियों को समझने के लिए कुछ सुझाव:

segments.src: 1. **Look at trends, not one number.** Compare results with prior quarters and with the same period a year ago.
segments.tr: 1. **प्रवृत्तियों को देखें, एक नंबर को नहीं।** पिछली तिमाहियों के साथ और एक साल पहले की समान अवधि के साथ परिणामों की तुलना करें।

segments.src: 2. **Pay attention to the tone of management.** Words such as "resilient," "normalizing" or "cautious" can signal how executives see the months ahead.
segments.tr: 2. **प्रबंधन के स्वर पर ध्यान दें।** "resilient," "normalizing" या "cautious" जैसे शब्द यह संकेत दे सकते हैं कि अधिकारी आने वाले महीनों को कैसे देखते हैं।

es.title: Comienza la temporada de resultados: lo que los informes de los grandes bancos podrían revelar sobre el consumidor estadounidense

segments.src: Third-quarter earnings season is about to begin, and the first reports will come from the country's largest lenders.
segments.tr: La temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre está a punto de comenzar, y los primeros informes provendrán de los mayores prestamistas del país.

segments.src: Investors usually watch these results for profit figures.
segments.tr: Los inversores suelen observar estos resultados en busca de cifras de beneficios.

segments.src: This quarter they will also read them as a check on household finances, because the banks see how millions of Americans borrow, spend and repay.
segments.tr: Este trimestre también los leerán como un examen de las finanzas de los hogares, porque los bancos ven cómo millones de estadounidenses piden prestado, gastan y pagan.

segments.src: ## Why Bank Earnings Matter Beyond Wall Street
segments.tr: ## Por qué los beneficios bancarios importan más allá de Wall Street

segments.src: Large banks sit at the center of consumer finance.
segments.tr: Los grandes bancos se encuentran en el centro de las finanzas de los consumidores.

segments.src: They issue credit cards, make auto and home loans, and process a large share of daily card payments.
segments.tr: Emiten tarjetas de crédito, otorgan préstamos para automóviles y viviendas, y procesan una gran parte de los pagos diarios con tarjeta.

segments.src: Their quarterly reports, and the commentary from executives on calls with analysts, offer a broad view of how households are doing.
segments.tr: Sus informes trimestrales, y los comentarios de los directivos en las llamadas con analistas, ofrecen una visión amplia de cómo están los hogares.

segments.src: That view is more current than many government statistics, which often arrive with a delay.
segments.tr: Esa visión es más actualizada que muchas estadísticas gubernamentales, que a menudo llegan con retraso.

segments.src: This quarter's question is whether consumers are managing under high interest rates and elevated prices.
segments.tr: La pregunta de este trimestre es si los consumidores se están arreglando con tipos de interés altos y precios elevados.

segments.src: Borrowing costs have stayed high for a long time, and the price of groceries, housing and insurance remains well above where it stood a few years ago.
segments.tr: Los costes de endeudamiento se han mantenido altos durante mucho tiempo, y el precio de los alimentos, la vivienda y los seguros sigue estando muy por encima de donde se encontraba hace unos años.

segments.src: Banks' own data should show how much strain that has caused.
segments.tr: Los propios datos de los bancos deberían mostrar cuánta presión ha causado eso.

segments.src: ## Three Things Investors Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## Tres cosas que los inversores estarán observando

segments.src: ### 1. Loan Defaults and Charge-Offs
segments.tr: ### 1. Impagos de préstamos y cancelaciones

segments.src: The first area is credit quality.
segments.tr: El primer área es la calidad crediticia.

segments.src: Analysts will look at **delinquency rates**, meaning the share of borrowers who have fallen behind on payments.
segments.tr: Los analistas observarán las **delinquency rates**, lo que significa la proporción de prestatarios que se han retrasado en los pagos.

segments.src: They will also look at **net charge-offs**, meaning the debts a bank has given up on collecting.
segments.tr: También observarán los **net charge-offs**, es decir, las deudas que un banco ha dado por perdidas para cobrar.

segments.src: Rising numbers here would suggest that some households are running out of room.
segments.tr: Un aumento de las cifras aquí sugeriría que a algunos hogares se les están acabando los márgenes.

segments.src: A stable or improving trend would support the view that the consumer is holding up.
segments.tr: Una tendencia estable o mejorable respaldaría la idea de que el consumidor se mantiene firme.

segments.src: Investors will also check how much money banks have set aside as a cushion for future losses, known as **loan-loss provisions**.
segments.tr: Los inversores también comprobarán cuánto dinero han reservado los bancos como colchón para futuras pérdidas, conocido como **loan-loss provisions**.

segments.src: A bank that increases its reserves is signaling more caution about what comes next.
segments.tr: Un banco que aumenta sus reservas está señalando más cautela sobre lo que viene después.

segments.src: ### 2. Credit Card Balances
segments.tr: ### 2. Saldos de tarjetas de crédito

segments.src: Credit card debt is a key indicator of household stress.
segments.tr: La deuda de tarjetas de crédito es un indicador clave del estrés de los hogares.

segments.src: Balances have grown over the past several years, and card interest rates are high.
segments.tr: Los saldos han crecido en los últimos años y los tipos de interés de las tarjetas son altos.

segments.src: Analysts will compare balance growth with the pace of spending to judge whether people are borrowing for convenience or because they need to cover everyday costs.
segments.tr: Los analistas compararán el crecimiento de los saldos con el ritmo de gasto para juzgar si la gente está pidiendo prestado por comodidad o porque necesita cubrir los costes cotidianos.

segments.src: Payment behavior matters as well.
segments.tr: El comportamiento de pago también importa.

segments.src: If more cardholders are paying only the minimum, or if late payments are increasing, that can be an early sign of trouble.
segments.tr: Si más titulares de tarjetas pagan solo el mínimo, o si los pagos atrasados aumentan, eso puede ser una señal temprana de problemas.

segments.src: Lenders often say which income groups are driving these trends, and those comments can be informative.
segments.tr: Los prestamistas a menudo dicen qué grupos de ingresos están impulsando estas tendencias, y esos comentarios pueden ser informativos.

segments.src: ### 3. Consumer Spending Patterns
segments.tr: ### 3. Patrones de gasto del consumidor

segments.src: Banks also report how much customers are spending on debit and credit cards.
segments.tr: Los bancos también informan cuánto gastan los clientes con tarjetas de débito y crédito.

segments.src: This gives a near real-time reading on the economy, since consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: Esto proporciona una lectura casi en tiempo real de la economía, ya que el gasto del consumidor representa aproximadamente dos tercios de la economía de EE.

segments.src: economic activity.
segments.tr: UU. en actividad económica.

segments.src: Analysts will look at whether spending is broad-based or concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: Los analistas examinarán si el gasto está generalizado o concentrado entre los hogares de mayores ingresos.

segments.src: In recent quarters, some lenders have described a "two-speed" consumer.
segments.tr: En trimestres recientes, algunos prestamistas han descrito a un consumidor de "dos velocidades".

segments.src: Wealthier households continue to spend on travel and dining, while lower- and middle-income households are more careful and look for deals.
segments.tr: Los hogares más adinerados continúan gastando en viajes y cenas, mientras que los hogares de ingresos bajos y medios son más cuidadosos y buscan ofertas.

segments.src: Executives' remarks on this split are likely to draw attention.
segments.tr: Es probable que los comentarios de los directivos sobre esta división atraigan la atención.

segments.src: ## Other Factors in the Picture
segments.tr: ## Otros factores en el panorama

segments.src: Bank profits depend on more than consumer behavior.
segments.tr: Los beneficios bancarios dependen de algo más que el comportamiento del consumidor.

segments.src: Several other themes may come up in this round of reports:
segments.tr: Varios otros temas pueden surgir en esta ronda de informes:

segments.src: - **Net interest income:** The gap between what banks earn on loans and what they pay on deposits. Changes in interest rates affect this figure.
segments.tr: - **Net interest income:** La brecha entre lo que los bancos ganan en préstamos y lo que pagan en depósitos. Los cambios en los tipos de interés afectan a esta cifra.

segments.src: - **Investment banking and trading:** Revenue from deal-making and markets can offset weakness elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Investment banking and trading:** Los ingresos de la intermediación de acuerdos y los mercados pueden compensar la debilidad en otras áreas.

segments.src: - **Commercial real estate:** Some lenders still face questions about office properties and other commercial loans.
segments.tr: - **Commercial real estate:** Algunos prestamistas todavía se enfrentan a preguntas sobre propiedades de oficinas y otros préstamos comerciales.

segments.src: - **The labor market:** Job security is the main support for household finances. Executives' comments on employment trends among their customers can shape how investors read the results.
segments.tr: - **The labor market:** La seguridad laboral es el principal apoyo para las finanzas de los hogares. Los comentarios de los directivos sobre las tendencias de empleo entre sus clientes pueden moldear la forma en que los inversores interpretan los resultados.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Results
segments.tr: ## Cómo leer los resultados

segments.src: A single quarter rarely settles the debate.
segments.tr: Un solo trimestre rara vez zanja el debate.

segments.src: Some tips for making sense of the headlines:
segments.tr: Algunos consejos para dar sentido a los titulares:

segments.src: 1. **Look at trends, not one number.** Compare results with prior quarters and with the same period a year ago.
segments.tr: 1. **Observe las tendencias, no un solo número.** Compare los resultados con trimestres anteriores y con el mismo período del año pasado.

segments.src: 2. **Pay attention to the tone of management.** Words such as "resilient," "normalizing" or "cautious" can signal how executives see the months ahead.
segments.tr: 2. **Preste atención al tono de la dirección.** Palabras como "resiliente", "normalizador" o "cauteloso" pueden indicar cómo ven los directivos los próximos meses.

segments.src: 3. **Compare across banks.** Lenders serve different customers, so differences between them can reveal where stress is building.
segments.tr: 3. **Compare entre bancos.** Los prestamistas sirven a diferentes clientes, por lo que las diferencias entre ellos pueden revelar dónde se está acumulando estrés.

segments.src: 4. **Remember the limits.** Bank data covers their own customers and may not represent every household.
segments.tr: 4. **Recuerde los límites.** Los datos bancarios cubren a sus propios clientes y pueden no representar a todos los hogares.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa para los hogares cotidianos

segments.src: For people outside the investing world, these reports are still a useful guide.
segments.tr: Para las personas ajenas al mundo de la inversión, estos informes siguen siendo una guía útil.

segments.src: They can indicate whether credit may become harder to get, whether lenders expect more borrowers to struggle, and how companies see the strength of the economy.
segments.tr: Pueden indicar si el crédito puede volverse más difícil de obtener, si los prestamistas esperan que más prestatarios tengan dificultades y cómo ven las empresas la solidez de la economía.

segments.src: If banks report rising defaults and tighter lending standards, borrowing could become more expensive or harder to qualify for.
segments.tr: Si los bancos informan de un aumento de los impagos y de estándares de préstamo más estrictos, el endeudamiento podría encarecerse o ser más difícil de calificar.

segments.src: If they report solid repayment and steady spending, that supports the case that the economy is on stable footing.
segments.tr: Si informan de reembolsos sólidos y un gasto constante, eso respalda el argumento de que la economía se encuentra sobre una base estable.

segments.src: Whatever the numbers show, it is a good time for households to review their own finances: check card balances and interest rates, build an emergency fund where possible, and understand the terms of any variable-rate debt.
segments.tr: Independientemente de lo que muestren las cifras, es un buen momento para que los hogares revisen sus propias finanzas: comprobar los saldos de las tarjetas y los tipos de interés, crear un fondo de emergencia cuando sea posible y entender las condiciones de cualquier deuda a tipo variable.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: The coming bank reports will offer an early and detailed look at the state of the American consumer.
segments.tr: Los próximos informes bancarios ofrecerán una visión temprana y detallada del estado del consumidor estadounidense.

segments.src: Investors will be searching for signs of whether households can keep up with high rates and prices.
segments.tr: Los inversores buscarán señales sobre si los hogares pueden seguir el ritmo de los altos tipos de interés y precios.

segments.src: The answers will influence expectations for the economy, for interest rates and for the earnings reports that follow from companies across the market.
segments.tr: Las respuestas influirán en las expectativas para la economía, para los tipos de interés y para los informes de resultados que sigan de las empresas en todo el mercado.

fr.title: La saison des résultats commence : ce que les rapports des grandes banques pourraient révéler sur le consommateur américain

segments.src: Third-quarter earnings season is about to begin, and the first reports will come from the country's largest lenders.
segments.tr: La saison des résultats du troisième trimestre est sur le point de commencer, et les premiers rapports proviendront des plus grands prêteurs du pays.

segments.src: Investors usually watch these results for profit figures.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs surveillent généralement ces résultats pour connaître les chiffres des bénéfices.

segments.src: This quarter they will also read them as a check on household finances, because the banks see how millions of Americans borrow, spend and repay.
segments.tr: Ce trimestre, ils les liront également comme un test de la santé financière des ménages, car les banques constatent comment des millions d'Américains empruntent, dépensent et remboursent.

segments.src: ## Why Bank Earnings Matter Beyond Wall Street
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les bénéfices des banques comptent au-delà de Wall Street

segments.src: Large banks sit at the center of consumer finance.
segments.tr: Les grandes banques se trouvent au centre de la finance de consommation.

segments.src: They issue credit cards, make auto and home loans, and process a large share of daily card payments.
segments.tr: Elles émettent des cartes de crédit, accordent des prêts automobiles et immobiliers, et traitent une grande partie des paiements quotidiens par carte.

segments.src: Their quarterly reports, and the commentary from executives on calls with analysts, offer a broad view of how households are doing.
segments.tr: Leurs rapports trimestriels, ainsi que les commentaires des dirigeants lors des appels avec les analystes, offrent une vision globale de la situation des ménages.

segments.src: That view is more current than many government statistics, which often arrive with a delay.
segments.tr: Cette vision est plus actuelle que de nombreuses statistiques gouvernementales, qui arrivent souvent avec du retard.

segments.src: This quarter's question is whether consumers are managing under high interest rates and elevated prices.
segments.tr: La question de ce trimestre est de savoir si les consommateurs s'en sortent face à des taux d'intérêt élevés et des prix élevés.

segments.src: Borrowing costs have stayed high for a long time, and the price of groceries, housing and insurance remains well above where it stood a few years ago.
segments.tr: Les coûts d'emprunt sont restés élevés pendant longtemps, et le prix de l'épicerie, du logement et des assurances reste bien supérieur à ce qu'il était il y a quelques années.

segments.src: Banks' own data should show how much strain that has caused.
segments.tr: Les propres données des banques devraient montrer quelle pression cela a causé.

segments.src: ## Three Things Investors Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## Trois éléments que les investisseurs vont surveiller

segments.src: ### 1. Loan Defaults and Charge-Offs
segments.tr: ### 1. Défauts de paiement et radiations

segments.src: The first area is credit quality.
segments.tr: Le premier domaine est la qualité du crédit.

segments.src: Analysts will look at **delinquency rates**, meaning the share of borrowers who have fallen behind on payments.
segments.tr: Les analystes examineront les **delinquency rates**, c'est-à-dire la proportion d'emprunteurs qui ont pris du retard sur leurs paiements.

segments.src: They will also look at **net charge-offs**, meaning the debts a bank has given up on collecting.
segments.tr: Ils examineront également les **net charge-offs**, c'est-à-dire les dettes qu'une banque a renoncé à recouvrer.

segments.src: Rising numbers here would suggest that some households are running out of room.
segments.tr: Des chiffres en hausse ici suggéreraient que certains ménages arrivent à bout de souffle.

segments.src: A stable or improving trend would support the view that the consumer is holding up.
segments.tr: Une tendance stable ou en amélioration soutiendrait l'idée que le consommateur tient bon.

segments.src: Investors will also check how much money banks have set aside as a cushion for future losses, known as **loan-loss provisions**.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs vérifieront également le montant que les banques ont mis de côté comme coussin pour les pertes futures, connu sous le nom de **loan-loss provisions**.

segments.src: A bank that increases its reserves is signaling more caution about what comes next.
segments.tr: Une banque qui augmente ses réserves signale une plus grande prudence quant à l'avenir.

segments.src: ### 2. Credit Card Balances
segments.tr: ### 2. Soldes des cartes de crédit

segments.src: Credit card debt is a key indicator of household stress.
segments.tr: La dette de carte de crédit est un indicateur clé du stress des ménages.

segments.src: Balances have grown over the past several years, and card interest rates are high.
segments.tr: Les soldes ont augmenté au cours des dernières années, et les taux d'intérêt des cartes sont élevés.

segments.src: Analysts will compare balance growth with the pace of spending to judge whether people are borrowing for convenience or because they need to cover everyday costs.
segments.tr: Les analystes compareront la croissance des soldes avec le rythme des dépenses pour juger si les gens empruntent par commodité ou parce qu'ils ont besoin de couvrir leurs coûts quotidiens.

segments.src: Payment behavior matters as well.
segments.tr: Le comportement de paiement compte également.

segments.src: If more cardholders are paying only the minimum, or if late payments are increasing, that can be an early sign of trouble.
segments.tr: Si un plus grand nombre de titulaires de carte ne paient que le minimum, ou si les retards de paiement augmentent, cela peut être un signe précoce de problème.

segments.src: Lenders often say which income groups are driving these trends, and those comments can be informative.
segments.tr: Les prêteurs indiquent souvent quels groupes de revenus alimentent ces tendances, et ces commentaires peuvent être instructifs.

segments.tr: ### 3. Modèles de dépenses de consommation

segments.tr: Les banques signalent également combien les clients dépensent sur leurs cartes de débit et de crédit.

segments.src: In recent quarters, some lenders have described a "two-speed" consumer.
segments.tr: Au cours des derniers trimestres, certains prêteurs ont décrit un consommateur à "deux vitesses".

segments.src: Wealthier households continue to spend on travel and dining, while lower- and middle-income households are more careful and look for deals.

segments.src: Lenders often say which income groups are driving these trends, and those comments can be informative.

segments.src: ### 3. Consumer Spending Patterns

segments.src: ## Other Factors in the Picture

segments.src: Several other themes may come up in this round of reports:

segments.src: - **Investment banking and trading:** Revenue from deal-making and markets can offset weakness elsewhere.

segments.src: - **Commercial real estate:** Some lenders still face questions about office properties and other commercial loans.

segments.src: - **The labor market:** Job security is the main support for household finances. Executives' comments on employment trends among their customers can shape how investors read the results.
segments.tr: - **労働市場:** 雇用の安定は家計の最大の支えです。顧客の雇用動向に関する経営陣のコメントは、投資家が結果をどう読み解くかに影響を与える可能性があります。

segments.src: ## How to Read the Results
segments.tr: ## 結果の読み方

segments.src: A single quarter rarely settles the debate.
segments.tr: 単一の四半期で議論が決着することはめったにありません。

segments.src: Some tips for making sense of the headlines:
segments.tr: 見出しを理解するためのヒントをいくつか紹介します。

segments.src: 1. **Look at trends, not one number.** Compare results with prior quarters and with the same period a year ago.
segments.tr: 1. **一つの数字ではなく、傾向を見る。** 前四半期や前年同期の結果と比較してください。

segments.src: 2. **Pay attention to the tone of management.** Words such as "resilient," "normalizing" or "cautious" can signal how executives see the months ahead.
segments.tr: 2. **経営陣のトーンに注目する。** 「回復力がある（resilient）」、「正常化している（normalizing）」、「慎重（cautious）」といった言葉は、経営陣が今後数ヶ月をどう見ているかを示唆します。

segments.src: 3. **Compare across banks.** Lenders serve different customers, so differences between them can reveal where stress is building.
segments.tr: 3. **銀行間で比較する。** 金融機関によって顧客層が異なるため、その違いからどこにストレスが蓄積しているかが明らかになることがあります。

segments.src: 4. **Remember the limits.** Bank data covers their own customers and may not represent every household.
segments.tr: 4. **限界を理解する。** 銀行のデータは自社の顧客を対象としており、すべての家計を代表しているわけではない可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## 一般家庭にとっての意味

segments.src: For people outside the investing world, these reports are still a useful guide.
segments.tr: 投資の世界の外にいる人々にとっても、これらの報告書は依然として有用な指針となります。

segments.src: They can indicate whether credit may become harder to get, whether lenders expect more borrowers to struggle, and how companies see the strength of the economy.

segments.src: If banks report rising defaults and tighter lending standards, borrowing could become more expensive or harder to qualify for.
segments.tr: もし銀行がデフォルトの増加や融資基準の厳格化を報告すれば、借り入れのコストが上昇したり、審査が厳しくなったりする可能性があります。

segments.src: If they report solid repayment and steady spending, that supports the case that the economy is on stable footing.

segments.src: Whatever the numbers show, it is a good time for households to review their own finances: check card balances and interest rates, build an emergency fund where possible, and understand the terms of any variable-rate debt.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line

segments.tr: Große Banken stehen im Zentrum der Verbraucherfinanzierung.

segments.src: They issue credit cards, make auto and home loans, and process a large share of daily card payments.
segments.tr: Sie geben Kreditkarten aus, vergeben Autokredite und Hypotheken und wickeln einen großen Teil der täglichen Kartenzahlungen ab.

segments.tr: Cái nhìn đó cập nhật hơn nhiều so với các số liệu thống kê của chính phủ, vốn thường đến với sự chậm trễ.

segments.src: This quarter's question is whether consumers are managing under high interest rates and elevated prices.
segments.tr: Câu hỏi của quý này là liệu người tiêu dùng có đang xoay xở được dưới áp lực của lãi suất cao và giá cả leo thang hay không.

segments.src: Borrowing costs have stayed high for a long time, and the price of groceries, housing and insurance remains well above where it stood a few years ago.
segments.tr: Chi phí vay mượn đã duy trì ở mức cao trong một thời gian dài, và giá thực phẩm, nhà ở và bảo hiểm vẫn cao hơn nhiều so với mức vài năm trước.

segments.src: Banks' own data should show how much strain that has caused.
segments.tr: Dữ liệu của chính các ngân hàng sẽ cho thấy điều đó đã gây ra căng thẳng đến mức nào.

segments.src: ## Three Things Investors Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## Ba điều các nhà đầu tư sẽ theo dõi

segments.src: ### 1. Loan Defaults and Charge-Offs
segments.tr: ### 1. Nợ xấu và xóa nợ

segments.src: The first area is credit quality.
segments.tr: Lĩnh vực đầu tiên là chất lượng tín dụng.

segments.src: Analysts will look at **delinquency rates**, meaning the share of borrowers who have fallen behind on payments.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích sẽ xem xét **tỷ lệ nợ quá hạn**, nghĩa là tỷ lệ người vay đã chậm trễ trong việc thanh toán.

segments.src: They will also look at **net charge-offs**, meaning the debts a bank has given up on collecting.
segments.tr: Họ cũng sẽ xem xét **tỷ lệ xóa nợ ròng**, nghĩa là các khoản nợ mà ngân hàng đã từ bỏ việc thu hồi.

segments.src: Rising numbers here would suggest that some households are running out of room.
segments.tr: Những con số gia tăng ở đây sẽ cho thấy một số hộ gia đình đang cạn kiệt nguồn lực.

segments.src: A stable or improving trend would support the view that the consumer is holding up.
segments.tr: Một xu hướng ổn định hoặc cải thiện sẽ củng cố quan điểm rằng người tiêu dùng vẫn đang trụ vững.

segments.src: Investors will also check how much money banks have set aside as a cushion for future losses, known as **loan-loss provisions**.
segments.tr: Các nhà đầu tư cũng sẽ kiểm tra xem các ngân hàng đã trích lập bao nhiêu tiền làm dự phòng cho các khoản lỗ trong tương lai, được gọi là **dự phòng rủi ro tín dụng**.

segments.src: A bank that increases its reserves is signaling more caution about what comes next.
segments.tr: Một ngân hàng tăng dự trữ của mình đang báo hiệu sự thận trọng hơn về những gì sắp xảy ra.

segments.src: ### 2. Credit Card Balances
segments.tr: ### 2. Dư nợ thẻ tín dụng

segments.src: Credit card debt is a key indicator of household stress.
segments.tr: Nợ thẻ tín dụng là một chỉ số quan trọng về căng thẳng tài chính hộ gia đình.

segments.src: Balances have grown over the past several years, and card interest rates are high.
segments.tr: Dư nợ đã tăng trong vài năm qua, và lãi suất thẻ tín dụng đang ở mức cao.

segments.src: Analysts will compare balance growth with the pace of spending to judge whether people are borrowing for convenience or because they need to cover everyday costs.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích sẽ so sánh mức tăng trưởng dư nợ với tốc độ chi tiêu để đánh giá liệu mọi người đang vay mượn vì sự tiện lợi hay vì họ cần trang trải các chi phí hàng ngày.

segments.src: Payment behavior matters as well.
segments.tr: Hành vi thanh toán cũng rất quan trọng.

segments.src: If more cardholders are paying only the minimum, or if late payments are increasing, that can be an early sign of trouble.
segments.tr: Nếu nhiều chủ thẻ chỉ thanh toán số tiền tối thiểu, hoặc nếu các khoản thanh toán trễ đang gia tăng, đó có thể là dấu hiệu sớm của rắc rối.

segments.src: Lenders often say which income groups are driving these trends, and those comments can be informative.
segments.tr: Các tổ chức cho vay thường cho biết nhóm thu nhập nào đang thúc đẩy các xu hướng này, và những bình luận đó có thể cung cấp thông tin hữu ích.

segments.src: ### 3. Consumer Spending Patterns
segments.tr: ### 3. Mô hình chi tiêu của người tiêu dùng

segments.src: Banks also report how much customers are spending on debit and credit cards.
segments.tr: Các ngân hàng cũng báo cáo số tiền khách hàng chi tiêu qua thẻ ghi nợ và thẻ tín dụng.

segments.src: This gives a near real-time reading on the economy, since consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: Điều này cung cấp một cái nhìn gần như thời gian thực về nền kinh tế, vì chi tiêu tiêu dùng chiếm khoảng hai phần ba hoạt động kinh tế của

segments.src: economic activity.
segments.tr: Mỹ.

segments.src: Analysts will look at whether spending is broad-based or concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích sẽ xem xét liệu chi tiêu có diễn ra trên diện rộng hay tập trung ở các hộ gia đình có thu nhập cao hơn.

segments.src: In recent quarters, some lenders have described a "two-speed" consumer.
segments.tr: Trong các quý gần đây, một số tổ chức cho vay đã mô tả một người tiêu dùng "hai tốc độ".

segments.src: Wealthier households continue to spend on travel and dining, while lower- and middle-income households are more careful and look for deals.
segments.tr: Các hộ gia đình giàu có hơn tiếp tục chi tiêu cho du lịch và ăn uống, trong khi các hộ gia đình có thu nhập thấp và trung bình cẩn trọng hơn và tìm kiếm các ưu đãi.

segments.src: Executives' remarks on this split are likely to draw attention.
segments.tr: Những nhận xét của các giám đốc điều hành về sự phân hóa này có khả năng thu hút sự chú ý.

segments.src: ## Other Factors in the Picture
segments.tr: ## Các yếu tố khác trong bức tranh toàn cảnh

segments.src: Bank profits depend on more than consumer behavior.
segments.tr: Lợi nhuận ngân hàng phụ thuộc vào nhiều yếu tố hơn là hành vi của người tiêu dùng.

segments.src: Several other themes may come up in this round of reports:
segments.tr: Một số chủ đề khác có thể xuất hiện trong đợt báo cáo này:

segments.src: - **Net interest income:** The gap between what banks earn on loans and what they pay on deposits. Changes in interest rates affect this figure.
segments.tr: - **Thu nhập lãi thuần:** Khoảng cách giữa những gì ngân hàng kiếm được từ các khoản vay và những gì họ trả cho tiền gửi. Những thay đổi về lãi suất ảnh hưởng đến con số này.

segments.src: - **Investment banking and trading:** Revenue from deal-making and markets can offset weakness elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Ngân hàng đầu tư và giao dịch:** Doanh thu từ việc thực hiện các thương vụ và thị trường có thể bù đắp cho sự yếu kém ở những nơi khác.

segments.src: - **Commercial real estate:** Some lenders still face questions about office properties and other commercial loans.
segments.tr: - **Bất động sản thương mại:** Một số tổ chức cho vay vẫn phải đối mặt với các câu hỏi về bất động sản văn phòng và các khoản vay thương mại khác.

segments.src: - **The labor market:** Job security is the main support for household finances. Executives' comments on employment trends among their customers can shape how investors read the results.
segments.tr: - **Thị trường lao động:** An ninh việc làm là chỗ dựa chính cho tài chính hộ gia đình. Những bình luận của các giám đốc điều hành về xu hướng việc làm của khách hàng có thể định hình cách các nhà đầu tư đọc kết quả.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Results
segments.tr: ## Cách đọc kết quả

segments.src: A single quarter rarely settles the debate.
segments.tr: Một quý đơn lẻ hiếm khi giải quyết được vấn đề tranh luận.

segments.src: Some tips for making sense of the headlines:
segments.tr: Một số mẹo để hiểu các tiêu đề:

segments.src: 1. **Look at trends, not one number.** Compare results with prior quarters and with the same period a year ago.
segments.tr: 1. **Nhìn vào xu hướng, không phải một con số.** So sánh kết quả với các quý trước và cùng kỳ năm ngoái.

segments.src: 2. **Pay attention to the tone of management.** Words such as "resilient," "normalizing" or "cautious" can signal how executives see the months ahead.
segments.tr: 2. **Chú ý đến giọng điệu của ban quản lý.** Các từ như "kiên cường", "bình thường hóa" hoặc "thận trọng" có thể báo hiệu cách các giám đốc điều hành nhìn nhận những tháng tới.

segments.src: 3. **Compare across banks.** Lenders serve different customers, so differences between them can reveal where stress is building.
segments.tr: 3. **So sánh giữa các ngân hàng.** Các tổ chức cho vay phục vụ các khách hàng khác nhau, vì vậy sự khác biệt giữa họ có thể tiết lộ nơi căng thẳng đang gia tăng.

segments.src: 4. **Remember the limits.** Bank data covers their own customers and may not represent every household.
segments.tr: 4. **Ghi nhớ các giới hạn.** Dữ liệu ngân hàng chỉ bao gồm khách hàng của chính họ và có thể không đại diện cho mọi hộ gia đình.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## Điều đó có ý nghĩa gì đối với các hộ gia đình hàng ngày

segments.src: For people outside the investing world, these reports are still a useful guide.
segments.tr: Đối với những người ngoài thế giới đầu tư, các báo cáo này vẫn là một hướng dẫn hữu ích.

segments.src: They can indicate whether credit may become harder to get, whether lenders expect more borrowers to struggle, and how companies see the strength of the economy.
segments.tr: Chúng có thể chỉ ra liệu tín dụng có thể trở nên khó tiếp cận hơn hay không, liệu các tổ chức cho vay có dự đoán nhiều người vay sẽ gặp khó khăn hơn hay không, và các công ty nhìn nhận sức mạnh của nền kinh tế như thế nào.

segments.src: If banks report rising defaults and tighter lending standards, borrowing could become more expensive or harder to qualify for.
segments.tr: Nếu các ngân hàng báo cáo tình trạng nợ xấu gia tăng và các tiêu chuẩn cho vay thắt chặt hơn, việc vay mượn có thể trở nên đắt đỏ hơn hoặc khó đủ điều kiện hơn.

segments.src: If they report solid repayment and steady spending, that supports the case that the economy is on stable footing.
segments.tr: Nếu họ báo cáo việc trả nợ vững chắc và chi tiêu ổn định, điều đó củng cố lập luận rằng nền kinh tế đang ở trên nền tảng ổn định.

segments.src: Whatever the numbers show, it is a good time for households to review their own finances: check card balances and interest rates, build an emergency fund where possible, and understand the terms of any variable-rate debt.
segments.tr: Dù các con số cho thấy điều gì, đây là thời điểm tốt để các hộ gia đình xem xét lại tài chính của chính mình: kiểm tra số dư thẻ và lãi suất, xây dựng quỹ khẩn cấp nếu có thể, và hiểu các điều khoản của bất kỳ khoản nợ lãi suất thả nổi nào.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The coming bank reports will offer an early and detailed look at the state of the American consumer.
segments.tr: Các báo cáo ngân hàng sắp tới sẽ cung cấp một cái nhìn sớm và chi tiết về tình trạng của người tiêu dùng Mỹ.

segments.src: Investors will be searching for signs of whether households can keep up with high rates and prices.
segments.tr: Các nhà đầu tư sẽ tìm kiếm các dấu hiệu về việc liệu các hộ gia đình có thể theo kịp với lãi suất và giá cả cao hay không.

segments.src: The answers will influence expectations for the economy, for interest rates and for the earnings reports that follow from companies across the market.
segments.tr: Các câu trả lời sẽ ảnh hưởng đến kỳ vọng đối với nền kinh tế, đối với lãi suất và đối với các báo cáo thu nhập tiếp theo từ các công ty trên toàn thị trường.
